sleep-walker do "In this project-management app, open the edit form for the line item 'fwat3-n1 MTP Item A' (Project Items tab, project 'fwat3-n1 MTP Bench Project'), set its Status to 'Specified', and then SAVE/SUBMIT the form properly (there should be a save/submit/OK button — find and click it; the previous attempt changed the combobox but never saved). After saving, verify the item's status in the Project Items LIST view and report what it is now, plus any error text you saw." --session fwat3-n1 --json

sleep-walker do "In this project-management app, open the edit form for the line item 'fwat3-n1 MTP Item A' (Project Items tab, project 'fwat3-n1 MTP Bench Project'). The app refuses to save status 'Specified' until these fields are completed: Supplier, Supplier Code, Item Cost, Item Units, Unit. Fill them in with sensible values: pick an existing Supplier from the available options (there are Organisations in the app — choose one that is a supplier), set Supplier Code to 'MTP-A', set Item Cost to 150, set Item Units to 1, and pick a Unit (e.g. each / pcs / whatever options exist). Keep Status as 'Specified' and Budget Cost 150, Budget Margin 25. Then submit/save. If further validation errors appear, report their exact text and address them too. Once saved, verify in the Project Items LIST view that the item's status is now 'Specified' and report the status marker/text, plus exactly which fields you had to fill and with what values." --session fwat3-n1 --json

sleep-walker do "In this project-management app, delete the two line items 'fwat3-n1 MTP Item A' and 'fwat3-n1 MTP Item B' from the Project Items tab (both belong to project 'fwat3-n1 MTP Bench Project'). Use whatever delete/remove control the app provides (row action, edit form delete button, etc.), confirming any confirmation dialog. List views refresh asynchronously after a delete, so wait and re-check. After both deletions, verify neither item appears in the Project Items list any more and report the Project Items tab count and confirmation text shown." --session fwat3-n1 --json

sleep-walker do "In this project-management app, close/archive the project named 'fwat3-n1 MTP Bench Project' so it is no longer active. Go to the Projects tab, open the project's edit form (double-click the row or use its edit control), and find a Close/Archive/Mark Closed control or a status field that can be set to closed/archived. Use it, confirming any dialog. If the app enforces preconditions for closing (e.g. error text), report the exact text and satisfy them. Afterwards verify the project no longer appears in the active Projects list (note there is an 'Include Closed' checkbox — you may use it to confirm the project is closed but still exists). Report exactly what you did, any confirmation/error text, and the Projects tab count before and after." --session fwat3-n1 --json

sleep-walker do "Final verification, read-only — do not change anything. In this project-management app: (1) On the Projects tab with 'Include Closed' UNCHECKED, confirm whether any project whose name contains 'fwat3-n1' appears in the active list, and report the active project count. (2) On the Project Items tab, confirm whether any item whose name contains 'fwat3-n1' appears, and report the item count. (3) With 'Include Closed' CHECKED on the Projects tab, confirm the project 'fwat3-n1 MTP Bench Project' is listed and report its status as shown. Report all three findings." --session fwat3-n1 --json

finalText:
All objectives complete. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Project `fwat3-n1 MTP Bench Project` created (internal reference `c6cgr13p134`). It appeared as a new row in the Projects list (tab count 2 → 3), with Margin %, Client and End Date showing `--`.

**2. DONE** — Line item `fwat3-n1 MTP Item A` created with Budget Cost 100 and Budget Margin % 25. The app computed **Budget Price = 133.33** (formula: cost / (1 − margin/100) = 100 / 0.75). Initial status: **Placeholder** (marker "P").

**3. DONE** — Line item `fwat3-n1 MTP Item B` created with Budget Cost 200 and Budget Margin % 25. The app computed **Budget Price = 266.67** (200 / 0.75). Status: Placeholder.

**4. DONE** — Item A's Budget Cost changed from 100 to 150 (margin kept at 25). The app recomputed **Budget Price = 200.00** (150 / 0.75).

**5. DONE** — Item A's status ended as **Specified** (verified in the list view: marker with `data-status="Specified"`, aria-label "Status: Specified"). The preconditions the app enforced, discovered by attempting the save: it rejected the change with the exact alert text **"Cannot save — please complete or correct: Supplier, Supplier Code, Item Cost, Item Units, Unit"**. What was required to satisfy them: fill in **Supplier = "Supplier One"** (chosen from the existing organisations), **Supplier Code = "MTP-A"**, **Item Cost = 150**, **Item Units = 1**, **Unit = "item"**. After filling those five fields the save was accepted. (Note: the first attempt changed the status combobox but was never submitted, so the list still showed Placeholder until a proper Submit was made.)

**6. DONE** — Both line items removed: each was deleted via its edit form's Delete button, with a confirm dialog **"Remove this project item?"** accepted each time. Project Items tab count went 9 → 7 and a re-check confirmed neither `fwat3-n1` item remains. The project was then closed by setting its Status from **Open → Closed** in its edit form and submitting (no preconditions, no error). Active Projects count went 3 → 2; with "Include Closed" checked the project `fwat3-n1 MTP Bench Project` is still listed with status **Closed**. Nothing created by this run remains active.
